newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bel-20 end off highs after sparkling session.
newsitem.headline: Bel-20 end off highs after sparkling session.

text.p: Bel-20 index of leading shares ends 2.4 percent higher on Wednesday after slipping from intra-day highs in line with Wall Street following comments by Federal Reserve Vice Chair Alice Rivlin.
* Rivlin warned of the risk of higher U.S. inflation and said it was a "tough call" to decide whether the central bank needed to raise interest rates further.
* Bel-20 index ends 62.04 points higher at 2,601.56 after earlier setting a record high at 2,606.88.
